subject: Polaris Analytics — Procurement + Security Kickstart / calendar availability
messages:
From: Jason Lee <jason.lee@polarisanalytics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@polarisanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 13:14:00 -0400
Subject: Intro + procurement kickoff / scheduling

Hi Monica / Aditya,

We're ready to kick off the procurement & security review for Redwood. Procurement (cc'd) wants a short vendor onboarding session to cover timeline, SOW/contract path, what evidence you provide (SOC2 logs, retention), and a brief demo to help the team understand integration points.

Can you share 60-minute window options this week or early next? Our stakeholders: myself (platform owner), Amira Salem (security), and procurement team (procurement@polarisanalytics.com). Prefer afternoons EDT.

Thanks,
Jason
Jason Lee
Director, Platform Engineering
Polaris Analytics
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Jason Lee <jason.lee@polarisanalytics.com>, procurement@polarisanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + procurement kickoff / scheduling

Thanks Jason — happy to run this. Tagging SE to lead the demo.

Quick availability check (60 min):
- Wed Mar 24, 2027 — 2:00–3:00 PM EDT (preferred)
- Thu Mar 25, 2027 — 11:00 AM–12:00 PM EDT
- Fri Mar 26, 2027 — 3:30–4:30 PM EDT

If those don't work, share a couple of afternoons next week and we'll adapt. Proposed agenda (high level):
1) Introductions + procurement checklist (10m)
2) Security scope & evidence (10m)
3) 20m demo: integration points, network & data flow, RBAC
4) Rollout timeline, next steps, owners (15m)

Attachments: preliminary SOW draft (Polaris_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf). I'll upload a kickoff agenda and a short SE note to Drive.

Aditya — want to take lead on commercial/contract path during the call?
Stephanie — can you confirm if we need any pre-demo access or sample data from Polaris to make the session productive?

Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Jason Lee <jason.lee@polarisanalytics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@polarisanalytics.com, Amira Salem <amira.salem@polarisanalytics.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 16:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + procurement kickoff / scheduling

Monica — Wed Mar 24 2:00–3:00 PM EDT works for the group. Please include Amira (security) on the invite — she's cc'd. Procurement will send a calendar invite once we have a finalized time, but confirm on your side and we'll merge invites.

A few asks for the session:
- Short list of the security artifacts you typically provide (SOC2, retention policy, audit log samples).
- Any network diagrams or IP ranges we should review ahead of time.
- Commercial lead from our side will be Mei Chen (mei.chen@polarisanalytics.com) — adding her to the procurement distribution.

Thanks, and see you Wednesday.

Jason
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jason Lee <jason.lee@polarisanalytics.com>, procurement@polarisanalytics.com, Amira Salem <amira.salem@polarisanalytics.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Confirmed: Polaris / Redwood kickstart — Wed Mar 24, 2:00–3:00 PM EDT (calendar invite)

Thanks all — calendar invite sent from me (title: Redwood x Polaris — Procurement & Security Kickstart).

What we'll bring to the call:
- A short 1-page procurement checklist and checklist PDF (attached: redwood-kickoff-agenda.md)
- SOC2 summary + guidance on evidence request (we'll point you to the Drive folder during the call)
- Demo: SE will show an integration flow and token/security model (20 min)

Pre-reqs from Polaris:
- If possible, a simple network diagram (VPC / firewall egress) and a sample request pattern (RPS / typical prompt lengths) — helpful but not required.

Attachments: redwood-kickoff-agenda.md (agenda), Polaris_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf (we updated the commercial appendix per earlier notes). Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cPolarisKickstart

If procurement sends any redlines ahead of the call, Aditya and I will triage live. We'll plan a follow-up 30-minute contract touchpoint within 48–72 hours after the kickstart to capture action items.

See you Wed.

— Monica
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jason Lee <jason.lee@polarisanalytics.com>, Amira Salem <amira.salem@polarisanalytics.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 16:02:00 -0400
Subject: Pre-reqs for Wed's demo — quick tech note

Hi Jason / Amira — excited to run the demo today. Quick technical pre-reqs so we make the most of the 20-minute demo:
- If you can share a small sample payload (anonymized) or a representative prompt, please upload to the Drive folder before 1:30 PM EDT.
- If you expect us to demonstrate Private (VPC) options, let us know so we can prepare a simplified network diagram and expected egress IP ranges.
- No credentials needed for the demo; a read-only example request is enough.

I'll start the demo with a short architecture sketch and then show turnaround (latency/cost) differences for the workflow you described.

Thanks — Stephanie
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
